name: @arena/auth
description: Session protocol and primitives for Arena (Work Order B004; issue #69; docs/LLM-ARCHITECT-HANDOFF.md B004 acceptance block): the sealed session token protocol (opaque session id + HMAC-SHA256 seal over a canonical serialization, node:crypto only), the versioned SessionRecord (A034 SecurityPrincipal + TenantScopedRef provenance + B003 WorkspaceContext snapshot + opaque auth-method provenance + revocation epoch), the SessionStore port with typed fail-closed outcomes, the ARENA_SESSION_SECRET contract (missing/short secret => DISABLED, never a weak default key), the arena_session cookie contract, the in-memory FakeSessionStore (FT2.0 local parity) and the shared behavioral contract suite. Pure domain package: zero Next.js imports, zero provider names.
